title: FBI records on Karl Compton destroyed, FOIA reply
summary: Jesse Michels tells of FBI records on Karl Compton destroyed, FOIA reply, about 2006-2014 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Quote unquote, records which may [music] have been responsive to your request were destroyed August 30th, 2006.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, reads out a reply that a records researcher named John Greenwald received in April 2014 after asking the FBI, the US federal police agency, for its files on Karl Compton, a leading American physicist. The request was made under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone ask for government records, and the reply said records that might have answered it were destroyed on August 30, 2006. Michels raises it because, if those files held something about UFOs, it would mean part of the record is gone for good.
